mainEntity.name: What is a crypto influencer marketing agency and who is it for?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto influencer marketing agency plans, vets, briefs and activates KOLs (key opinion leaders) on YouTube, X and Telegram to drive awareness and on-chain conversion for Web3, DePIN and AI projects. It is the right fit for protocols running a TGE, mainnet launch, raise announcement or sustained community growth programme who need creator relationships and attribution tracking, not just follower count. Shilika Jain runs this work directly for $5K–$12K/month.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto KOL campaign cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: KOL pricing varies by tier. Nano creators ($200–$1.5K per post) are used for community seeding. Micro creators ($500–$5K) reach niche audiences with higher engagement rates. Mid-tier voices ($10K–$30K) carry category authority. Macro creators ($25K–$100K+) are used for broad market moments. A managed campaign retainer runs $5K–$12K/month including vetting, briefing and reporting, or a launch sprint runs $15K–$40K for a concentrated activation window.

mainEntity.name: Which platforms and regions do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Primary platforms: YouTube for long-form explainers, X for news-cycle speed, Telegram for community depth. Regional rosters cover Korea (high retail crypto activity), Japan, Vietnam, India and MENA. Western English-language creators are always included. Coverage depends on where your target wallet demographic is most active, which the KOL audit maps before activation begins.

mainEntity.name: How do you measure the results of a KOL campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every campaign is reported on cost-per-wallet: the number of unique on-chain wallets that connected, transacted or held after a KOL activation, divided by the creator fee paid. Secondary metrics include referral link clicks, Discord and Telegram joins attributed to each creator, and sentiment shift tracked across the campaign window. A ranked scorecard shows which KOLs drove the highest on-chain conversion, not just the most views.
